assessments.name: Final Exam
assessments.description: This will be a closed-book, supervised examination. Students may bring one A4 double-sided reference sheet, which may be handwritten, printed, or a combination of both.

assessments.name: Early Feedback Task
assessments.description: Testing the knowledge of the content taught in weeks 1 to 3

assessments.name: Assignment 1: AI-Assisted Security Investigation
assessments.description: Use AI assisted and other security analysis techniques to investigate vulnerabilities in a controlled software application. Analyse security weaknesses, evaluate their potential impact, and recommend appropriate mitigations.

assessments.name: Assignment 2: Security Review and Ethical Investigation
assessments.description: Evaluate security changes and potential risks in a software application, and conduct a scoped security investigation. Use evidence to assess security outcomes, propose validation or remediation approaches, and demonstrate responsible and ethical security
